assumptions: REQ-042 has an explicit ID in the source document, so it is used as requirement_reference.
Assumed the system shows a generic confirmation message for reset requests regardless of whether the email is registered, to avoid account enumeration; the requirement does not state this.
Assumed a reset link is single-use and becomes invalid immediately after a successful password change, even if the 30-minute window has not elapsed; the requirement does not state this explicitly.

Assumed the three-failed-attempt lockout counter is scoped per account and resets on a rolling one-hour basis from the first failure; the requirement does not specify the counter's scope or exact reset mechanics.
Assumed no additional password complexity rules (character classes, symbols) apply beyond the stated 12-character minimum and the previous-password-mismatch rule.
Assumed the reset request form has a single email field and the reset completion form has a single new-password field, with no explicit confirm-password field mentioned in the requirement.

Assumed 'expires after 30 minutes' means the link remains valid at exactly the 30-minute mark since issuance and only becomes invalid once strictly more than 30 minutes have elapsed; the requirement does not state whether the boundary is inclusive or exclusive.

Assumed the system rejects reset tokens that were never issued or have been tampered with, in addition to rejecting expired or already-used tokens; the requirement does not explicitly state this but it is required for the stated expiry and single-use rules to be enforceable.

test_cases.title: Request password reset with a registered email address
preconditions: A user account exists with a registered, verified email address
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter the registered email address in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: A confirmation message is displayed and a password reset link is sent to the registered email address

test_cases.title: Successfully set a new password via a valid unexpired reset link
preconditions: A registered user has requested a password reset and holds a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Click the reset link from the email within 30 minutes of issuance
Enter a new password that is at least 12 characters long and different from the previous password
Submit the new-password form
test_cases.expected_result: The password is updated successfully and a confirmation of the password change is displayed

test_cases.title: Log in successfully using the newly set password after a completed reset
preconditions: The user has successfully completed a password reset with a new password
steps: Navigate to the login page
Enter the registered email address and the newly set password
Submit the login form
test_cases.expected_result: The user is authenticated and granted access to their account using the new password

test_cases.title: Request password reset with an unregistered email address
preconditions: No account exists for the email address to be entered
steps: Navigate to the password reset request page
Enter an email address that is not registered in the system
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: A generic confirmation message is displayed identical to the registered-email case, and no reset email is sent, without revealing whether the email exists

test_cases.title: Attempt to use a reset link after it has expired
preconditions: A reset link was issued to a registered user more than 30 minutes ago and has not been used
steps: Wait until more than 30 minutes have elapsed since the reset link was issued
Click the expired reset link
Attempt to submit a new password on the resulting form
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating the reset link has expired is displayed and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Attempt to set a new password matching the previous password
preconditions: A registered user holds a valid, unexpired reset link and knows their previous password
steps: Click the valid reset link
Enter the previous password as the new password
Submit the new-password form
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating the new password must differ from the previous password is displayed and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Fourth reset attempt within one hour is blocked after three failures
preconditions: A registered user has already made three failed password reset attempts within the past hour
steps: Initiate a fourth password reset attempt for the same account within the same one-hour window
Submit the reset request or reset completion form
test_cases.expected_result: The system blocks the attempt and displays a message indicating further reset attempts are temporarily blocked

test_cases.title: Attempt to reuse an already-successfully-used reset link
preconditions: A registered user has already successfully used a reset link to change their password
steps: Click the same reset link a second time
Attempt to enter and submit a new password on the resulting form
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating the reset link is invalid or already used is displayed and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Attempt to use an invalid or tampered reset token
preconditions: A registered user account exists
No reset link with the token value to be used has ever been issued by the system, or a previously issued token has been altered
steps: Construct a reset URL using a token value that was never issued by the system, or modify one character of a previously issued valid token
Submit the resulting URL to open the reset completion page
Attempt to enter and submit a new password on the resulting form
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating the reset link is invalid is displayed and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Use the reset link at exactly the 30-minute expiry boundary
preconditions: A reset link was issued to a registered user exactly 30 minutes ago
steps: Click the reset link at precisely the 30-minute mark since issuance
Enter a new password that is at least 12 characters long and different from the previous password
Submit the new-password form
test_cases.expected_result: The reset link is still accepted as valid at exactly the 30-minute mark since issuance, and the password reset succeeds

test_cases.title: Use the reset link a few seconds before the 30-minute expiry
preconditions: A reset link was issued to a registered user just under 30 minutes ago
steps: Click the reset link a few seconds before the 30-minute expiry mark
Enter a new password that is at least 12 characters long and different from the previous password
Submit the new-password form
test_cases.expected_result: The password reset succeeds because the link is still within the valid 30-minute window

test_cases.title: Set a new password that is exactly 12 characters long
preconditions: A registered user holds a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Click the valid reset link
Enter a new password that is exactly 12 characters long and different from the previous password
Submit the new-password form
test_cases.expected_result: The password reset succeeds since 12 characters meets the minimum length requirement

test_cases.title: Attempt to set a new password that is 11 characters long
preconditions: A registered user holds a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Click the valid reset link
Enter a new password that is exactly 11 characters long
Submit the new-password form
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating the password must be at least 12 characters is displayed and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Third failed reset attempt within the hour is still allowed
preconditions: A registered user has already made two failed password reset attempts within the past hour
steps: Initiate a third password reset attempt for the same account within the same one-hour window
Cause the attempt to fail (e.g. by submitting an invalid new password)
test_cases.expected_result: The third attempt is processed normally without being blocked, since the lockout threshold of three failures has not yet been exceeded

test_cases.title: Failed-attempt counter resets and reset succeeds after the one-hour window elapses
preconditions: A registered user was blocked after three failed reset attempts within the past hour
steps: Wait until more than one hour has elapsed since the first counted failed attempt
Initiate a new password reset attempt for the same account
Complete the reset with a valid new password
test_cases.expected_result: The reset attempt is allowed and succeeds because the failed-attempt counter has reset after the rolling one-hour window elapsed

test_cases.title: Submit the reset request form with an empty email field
preconditions: The user is on the password reset request page
steps: Leave the Email field empty
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: A validation error message indicating the email field is required is displayed and no reset email is sent

test_cases.title: Submit the reset request form with a malformed email address
preconditions: The user is on the password reset request page
steps: Enter an invalid-format email address such as 'user@' in the Email field
Submit the reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: A validation error message indicating the email format is invalid is displayed and no reset email is sent

test_cases.title: Submit the new-password form with an empty password field
preconditions: A registered user holds a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Click the valid reset link
Leave the new-password field empty
Submit the new-password form
test_cases.expected_result: A validation error message indicating the password field is required is displayed and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Submit a new password containing only whitespace characters
preconditions: A registered user holds a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Click the valid reset link
Enter a password consisting only of whitespace characters (e.g. 12 space characters) in the new-password field
Submit the new-password form
test_cases.expected_result: A validation error message indicating the password is invalid or empty is displayed and the password is not changed

test_cases.title: Reset flow succeeds for an email address with plus-addressing and mixed case
preconditions: A registered account exists with email address 'user@example.com'
steps: Enter 'User+Test@Example.com' in the Email field on the reset request page
Submit the reset request form
Complete the reset using the link sent to the matching registered account
test_cases.expected_result: The reset request is matched to the registered account and the reset link is delivered and usable, confirming case-insensitive/canonical email matching

test_cases.title: Failed-attempt lockout counter is tracked per account, not globally
preconditions: Two distinct registered user accounts exist: Account A and Account B
steps: Cause three failed password reset attempts within one hour for Account A
Attempt a fourth reset for Account A and confirm it is blocked
Initiate a password reset attempt for Account B within the same time window
test_cases.expected_result: Account B's reset attempt is processed normally and is not blocked, confirming the lockout counter is isolated per account

test_cases.title: Reset link expiry is consistent across requests issued in different time zones
preconditions: Registered user accounts exist and reset requests can be issued from clients in different time zones
steps: Request a password reset from a client configured in one time zone and note the issuance time
Request a password reset for another account from a client configured in a different time zone
Attempt to use each reset link at 31 minutes after its respective issuance time
test_cases.expected_result: Both reset links expire consistently 30 minutes after issuance regardless of the requesting client's time zone, indicating expiry is computed on a consistent server-side clock
